anita (vendor-liaison): Quick sync ask — partners want a single carrier for the H200 / H100 embargo windows across NA/EU/APAC. Can we map dependencies (drivers, firmware, SI readiness) and propose regional staggered announce dates?
jordan (partnerships): Good call. Partners pushed for NA first, APAC last. Concern: MI300 firmware patch ETA is still fuzzy.
sam (product): We also need to align marketplace listing lead time (14 days preannounce for images). If firmware slips, we may need to swap to a compatible SKU.
leah (eng): MI300 firmware: vendor said epi-2 by Apr 18. Gaudi driver roll is independent but needs the new OCI image tags.
nate (solutions): For SIs, the checklist: driver validation, perf cert, integration docs, and a staged testbed. Can we commit lab slots?
anita (vendor-liaison): Lab slots are tight in late April. Proposal: NA announce week of Apr 29, EU week of May 13, APAC week of May 27. That gives two-week buffer between regions. Thoughts? :calendar:
jordan (partnerships): Works if firmware lands Apr 18. If not, fallback plan: H100/H200 public announce but GA for MI300 queued, with a clear "MI300 coming soon" note. Avoid embargo leaks.
sam (product): Agree. Also add a marketplace "soft-list" step: publish SKU placeholder + docs link 7 days before public press so integrators can start signing up.
leah (eng): Technical blockers: one, Gaudi runtime image needs a kernel bump we haven't merged yet; two, H200 telemetry hooks need a final flag from vendor. ETA for both ~Apr 22. If they slip past Apr 24 we miss NA date.
anita (vendor-liaison): I'll push vendor for hard commits on those two items by EOD Apr 20. If we don't get them, we shift NA to May 6.
nate (solutions): On SI readiness — recommend a mandatory smoke checklist and a one-day dry run in our staging cluster. I'll draft the checklist by tomorrow.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace image verification queue currently ~48 hours per image. Plan for verification window in timeline.
jordan (partnerships): Communication plan: 1) internal announce to GTM & legal on Apr 15, 2) embargoed partner packet by Apr 22, 3) public press on chosen regional date. Who owns the partner packet?
anita (vendor-liaison): I'll own the packet and coordinate with Sam for messaging. Can someone add a short compatibility table for the packet? Copy/paste friendly.
sam (product): I'll produce a 1-pager compatibility table (H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi) and a short ops note for marketplace images. ETA Apr 18.
leah (eng): I'll add kernel/telemetry status lines to the packet and include the failing test IDs if any.
anita (vendor-liaison): Action items recap: vendor commits by Apr 20 (anita), product 1-pager by Apr 18 (sam), eng status lines by Apr 18 (leah), SI checklist draft by Apr 15 (nate). If all green, NA Apr 29, EU May 13, APAC May 27.
jordan (partnerships): Thanks — tagging press-ops and legal in a follow-up thread. :thumbsup:
